### Definition of tangent

For an angle with measure $\theta$ in a right triangle:

$\tan(\theta)=\dfrac{\blueE{\text{opposite leg length}}}{\goldE{\text{adjacent leg length}}}$

### Identifying the sides opposite and adjacent to $\angle B$

The side $\blueE{\text{opposite}}$ to $\angle B$ is $\overline{AC}$ and its length is $\blueE{5}$ units.

The side $\goldE{\text{adjacent}}$ to $\angle B$ is $\overline{BC}$ and its length is $\goldE{12}$ units.

But $\tan(\beta)$ is the side opposite to $\angle B$ divided by the side *adjacent* to $\angle B$.
